action_consequence: Xu applies his wood-and-stone work analogy to an unfamiliar flat material; the teacher asks for evidence; he retracts the unsupported use while retaining the visible shape and uncertainty.
character_reaction: He changes his notes and explicitly declines to use the lesson as authority for identifying unfamiliar herb-field plants.
future_boundary: The second herb-field morning remains tomorrow; classroom objects are returned and the protagonist carries only his notes.
limitation: Repeated note-correction-uncertainty structure and explanatory dialogue still dominate; external conflict is weak. Added comparison details preserve continuity but do not establish commercial or long-form literary quality.
